name: OAuth 2.0 On-Behalf-Of flow (OBO)
short_description: An OAuth 2.0 flow in which a middle-tier service exchanges the token of the signed-in user for a token to a downstream API, so the downstream call is made with the user's identity and permissions.

evidence.quote: The on-behave for flow is a subtler but crucial pattern.
Entra on behalf of for delegated authority
It exchanges it using the OBO flow to obtain a new access token for the downstream API, like Microsoft Graph
It's built around on behalf of authentication, meaning your identity travels with the request.
The fix is delegated permissions with the on-be-half of flow.
Enter delegated permissions with the on behalf of flow.
